The inserted displacement is defined as the actual sum of the sampled u_k times the generated integerTranslation vectors assigned to the off-target rows. The insertionErrorCap is eventually nonnegative and RapidlySmall at the original gap auxiliary V. Its decay is derived from the actual cutoff sampling growth. It is not an input assumption, and every supported original good tuple and interval sample uses the same cap.

Original tail-before-gap ordering supplies every row tail divisor budget at most V. Actual tailMass support, nonnegativity and normalization imply 0<=integerDivisorMask<=V. The error insertionPowerError is defined as |unshiftedCorrelation|^(2^d)-|insertedCorrelation|^(2^d), not as zero or an unspecified small input.
